method: Reviewed official DENR-EMB CALABARZON page and report text surfaced in public search indexing. Direct page and PDF requests returned HTTP 403; no access-control bypass or local copy was attempted.

findings.claim: Maragondon River was included in DENR-EMB CALABARZON water-quality monitoring in 2018.
The EMB first-half 2020 assessment says monitoring of Cavite rivers, including Maragondon River, was conducted in January and February 2020.
The indexed EMB text lists the monitored rivers as Class C, a regulatory water-use classification that includes fishery use.

unavailableEvidence: Monitoring station coordinates or a station-to-reach map.
The station-specific measured values, methods, and quality-control records from the cited 2020 report.
A crosswalk from any Maragondon River monitoring station to Gapan/Sapang River or its one-kilometer Adopt-a-Waterbody segment.
interpretation: Historical monitoring and classification context for the named Maragondon River only. The source does not establish current water safety, fish occurrence, a complete species checklist, salinity, or full-channel geometry. The relation between Gapan/Sapang River and monitored Maragondon River reaches remains unresolved.
nextAction: Obtain a permitted copy of the 2020 assessment or station-level EMB monitoring data, confirm methods and exact station locations, then crosswalk stations to named channel reaches. Do not treat Class C as a present-day safety result or assign stations to Gapan/Sapang without evidence.
